outcome: Denver II findings (language and personal-social development)
cohort: The study included 125 preterm infants, comprising 65 from spontaneous and 60 from IVF multiple pregnancies.
finding: Morbidity, length of hospitalization, and neurodevelopmental outcome of preterm infants born after spontaneous and IVF multiple pregnancy are similar, with delays in language and personal-social development being the most common abnormalities.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery was significantly higher in the IVF group.
